name: Welfare Services for Other Socially Disabled Persons (Senior Citizens & Destitute)
benefit: > **Care & Shelter** - Old age homes and respite care homes. > **Healthcare** - Mobile medical units. - Physiotherapy clinics. > **Day Care Services** - Multi-service centres for elderly. > **Special Care** - Dementia/Alzheimer’s care centres. > **Support Services** - Counseling and helplines.
_eligibility_text: > **For Individuals (Beneficiaries):** - The applicant must be a senior citizen aged 65 years or above. - The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. - The applicant must be a destitute person without any regular means of livelihood. - The applicant must not have family members or relatives to provide financial or social support. > **For Organizations:** - The applicant must be a registered voluntary organization/NGO/institution. - The applicant must be engaged in providing welfare services for senior citizens or destitute persons. - The applicant must have adequate infrastructure such as old age homes, day care centres, or care facilities. - The applicant must have experience in implementing elderly care or social welfare programmes. - The applicant must ensure that services are provided without discrimination on any grounds.
